risks.description: Current supported config remains a small baseline and is not generalized to broader SRAM families.
risks.recommended_next_action: Expand the flow to more sizes/ports after C6.

risks.description: Some pin accesses were synthesized in C2 rather than extracted from original hardmacro pin geometry.
risks.recommended_next_action: Replace synthesized pins with tech-extracted pin shapes where possible.

risks.description: C4/C5 routing is geometry-backed prototype routing, not a signoff detailed router result.
risks.recommended_next_action: Refine routing/via/contact stacks with technology-aware detailed routing.

risks.description: DRC is not guaranteed clean unless the smoke run returns zero markers with valid deck/tool evidence.
risks.recommended_next_action: Fix markers or improve layer mapping until DRC smoke is clean.

risks.description: LVS is not yet proven because final top-level netlist/deck/pin mapping remains incomplete.
risks.recommended_next_action: Generate final SRAM CDL/SPICE and top-level mapping, then run actual LVS.

risks.description: Timing closure, RC extraction, and PEX were not performed.
risks.recommended_next_action: Add extracted parasitics and timing analysis flow.

risks.description: Multi-bank, multi-port, and write-mask support are not covered by this final supported config flow.
risks.recommended_next_action: Extend the generator and validation plan per configuration dimension.

risks.description: Layer/via/contact stack assumptions may still require tech-specific refinement for production-quality layout.
risks.recommended_next_action: Refine geometry to match technology deck expectations.

risks.description: OpenYield logical net mapping to LVS-ready top-level SPICE/CDL still needs explicit closure.
risks.recommended_next_action: Emit final top-level netlist and pin-order contract for LVS.

risks.description: The final deliverable is complete only in the sense of geometry-backed connectivity for the current supported config, not tapeout readiness.
risks.recommended_next_action: Keep final claim boundary explicit in handoff materials.
